content:
Hello Lean enthusiasts! :wave:

We wanted to let you know about studies that are being run on Prolific, an online research platform where users get paid to take part in tasks from leading organisations like Google, Meta, University of Oxford, and many others. There is a lot of demand for participants with Lean knowledge.

Studies involving Lean most often consist of formalizing math problems. This requires a good working knowledge of Lean 3 and mathlib, and should hopefully be fun! The pay varies depending on the task, but is in the range of £20-25/hour.

If you're interested, you can fill out this form, and we’ll send you a signup link to create a Prolific account. Once you set up your account, you’ll get notified when a new study is available to you, how much it pays, and how long it takes to complete.

If you’re curious to know how the platform works, you can always check out our subreddit and hear from our existing participants.

Feel free to reply to this thread or send me a direct message if you have any questions!
